verified_notes: Verified against the vendored script on 2026-09-23, replacing a spec that had guessed this one from the README and marked itself unverified. `jev_gate.py` is self-contained (275 lines, no dependencies), reads the PreToolUse event on stdin, and backs onto OpenRouter (`typesafe/jev-1.13`), reading OPENROUTER_API_KEY or TYPESAFE_API_KEY. A live --explain returned source `model` with p and confidence, so the path is real. TWO traps. (1) It ships in `observe` mode, which decides and logs and blocks NOTHING; the row would be an allow-everything sheet at its default. JEV_GATE_MODE=enforce is set so the decision it reaches is the decision that is scored, and the arm's notes say observe is what a user gets. (2) On the hook path allow and ask are the SAME exit code, and in enforce mode deny and ask are BOTH exit 2 -- the exit code cannot carry the answer. Its own decision log can, so that is what is read. Its failure mode is `source: fallback` with verdict `ask` ('no API key set' / 'model unreachable'), which would otherwise score as a real hedge, so fallback is an error here and the case goes unanswered.
